text:
maya: Heads-up: launch + webinar in 10 days. Need a compact benchmark asset bundle: hero banner (1200x628), slide hero (1920x1080), three microtiles (600x400), one-pager PDF, and a one-diagram inbound routing SVG. Focus: latency (ms) vs cost ($/k tokens) with clear routing rules for hosted/dedicated/private. First comps by Fri EOD. :rocket:

trent: Copy. Drop data and preferred colors? Also mobile-first variants?

maya: Data here: https://files.redwood/bench/summary.csv. Use latency on x, cost on y. Include a small inset sparkline for per-token cost. Colors: Brand Blue #0A6AFF for latency, Coral #FF6B61 for cost. Provide light/dark logo variants and 24px clearspace.

aria: Design notes: Inter for body, Inter-SemiBold for headings. Microtiles should include one-line insight + 1-line metric. Run AA contrast check and provide alt text. Motion: small sparkline draw only, <7s.

trent: For routing diagram, what form tags? Example mapping?

maya: Form tags: source, plan, intent. Routing: hosted -> marketing-nurture, dedicated -> sales-queue, private -> partner-engage. Include CSV sample in the ticket: form_field,webhook_key; utm_source,source; plan_choice,plan; interest,intent. Note: redact keys in examples.

design-bot: Ticket DESIGN-6001 created  assignee: trent, due: 1795620000.

legal: Quick flag: if we mention third-party models or % improvements, include attribution and cite sources. We'll review comps after upload.

trent: I'll mock 2 hero variants (A/B headline) + the microtiles, add export slices and a PDF template. Will upload PNGs + figma link by Fri EOD. Ping here if blocked. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks — CTA options: "Try Hosted API", "Book Dedicated Demo", "Download one-pager". Keep headline short (<=6 words) for hero A and a longer variant for hero B.
